learning_outcomes.text: Possesses terminology related to museology and museography.
Possesses the theoretical background related to museology and museography.
Understands the interaction between the theoretical and practical fields of museums.
Possesses knowledge about museology and museography studies.
Acquires knowledge about the conservation, research, and communication functions of museums.

syllabus_topics: Definition and scope of the museum, social role and basic functions of the museum, definition and scope of museography
Process of collection formation from ancient times to the present, museums and museographic studies between the 16th-18th centuries
Museums and museographic studies between the 19th-20th centuries, concepts discussed in museology, legal regulations, new museum types
Museums and museology approach in the 21st century
History of museology in the Ottoman Empire, museology and museographic studies
History of museology in Turkey, museology and museographic studies
Museum personnel scheme and specializations, conservation and security in museums
Collection management and research in museums
